query: In 2018, would Denmark have passed the public-finance and price-stability tests a European Union member must meet before adopting the euro? Use October 2025 WEO annual-average CPI inflation as the price measure, take the 27 current EU members as the comparison group, and apply the criteria strictly with no leeway for improving trends.

text.text: Identifies that the answer applies the Maastricht (euro-adoption) convergence criteria: deficit at or below 3 percent of GDP, debt at or below 60 percent, inflation within 1.5 pp of the three best performers.
text.accept: full = names the Maastricht / euro convergence criteria; acceptable alternatives: EMU entry tests; no = Stability and Growth Pact fiscal rules only, debt sustainability analysis, or fiscal-rule calibration

text.text: States deficit met; debt met; inflation met (3 of 3 tests met: deficit, debt, inflation)
text.accept: full = verdict per test matches the recomputation

data.text: Uses WEO general government net lending/borrowing (GGXCNL_NGDP), gross debt (GGXWDG_NGDP) and CPI inflation (PCPIPCH) for EU27.

computation.text: Euro-entry inflation limit in 2018 = mean of the three lowest EU inflation rates plus 1.5 pp = 2.23 %
computation.accept: full = within 0.3 pp (simple average of three lowest EU rates, consumer prices)

computation.text: Denmark inflation minus that limit in 2018 = -1.52 pp
Denmark general government deficit in 2018 = -0.81 % of GDP (limit 3)
Denmark gross public debt in 2018 = 38.5 % of GDP (limit 60)

assembled_from: IMF WEO Oct 1996 (EMU and the World Economy), convergence-table notes
provenance.selection: EU27 country-years 2012-2024 where deficit is 0.4pp+ from 3, debt 3pp+ from 60, inflation 0.4pp+ from the limit; seeded draw; one per country

gold_report_note: No corpus country report is the gold source; values are recomputed from frozen WEO. Proxy caveat: consumer-price inflation (PCPIPCH) stands in for the treaty HICP measure, and the three lowest rates are taken over all EU27 without outlier screening (the note says a simple average of the three is used for illustration).
distractors: Stability and Growth Pact fiscal-rule compliance
